mod = 1000000007

class M:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.s = [[0]*(size) for _ in range(size)]
        self.n = size

    def __mul__(self, other):
        c = M(self.n)
        for i in range(self.n):
            for j in range(self.n):
                total = 0
                for k in range(self.n):
                    total += self.s[i][k] * other.s[k][j]
                c.s[i][j] = total % mod
        return c

def main():
    n, m = map(int, input().split())
    size = m + 1
    bi = [[M(size) for _ in range(65)] for _ in range(65)]
    I = M(size)

    # Initialize bi[0][0]
    bi[0][0].n = size
    for i in range(size):
        bi[0][0].s[i][i] = 1
        bi[0][0].s[0][i] = 1

    x, y, z, add = 0, 1, 0, 0
    while y * m <= n:
        y *= m
        x += 1

    for t in range(x + 1):
        if t:
            bi[t][0] = bi[t - 1][0]
            for i in range(1, m):
                bi[t][0] = bi[t][0] * bi[t - 1][i]
        for i in range(1, m):
            bi[t][i] = bi[t][i - 1]
            for j in range(m - 2, -1, -1):
                for k in range(size):
                    bi[t][i].s[j][k], bi[t][i].s[j + 1][k] = bi[t][i].s[j + 1][k], bi[t][i].s[j][k]
            for j in range(m - 2, -1, -1):
                for k in range(size):
                    bi[t][i].s[k][j], bi[t][i].s[k][j + 1] = bi[t][i].s[k][j + 1], bi[t][i].s[k][j]

    # Initialize identity matrix I
    I.n = size
    for i in range(size):
        I.s[i][i] = 1

    while add < n:
        if add + y <= n:
            add += y
            I = I * bi[x][z]
            z = (z + 1) % m
        else:
            y //= m
            x -= 1

    ans = 0
    for i in range(size):
        ans = (ans + I.s[i][m]) % mod
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
